scenario.summary: Threat actors use social engineering on X (Twitter) to lure targets into a malicious Google Doc featuring an Apps Script sidebar. This sidebar delivers OS-specific payloads, including AMOS stealer for macOS and NetSupport RAT for Windows, utilizing ClickFix-style prompts and fake installers to achieve persistence and data exfiltration.

meta.rationale: Focus on endpoints (Windows and macOS) potentially belonging to conference attendees. Check logs starting from August 9, 2026.
meta.hypothesis: Adversaries are delivering malware via malicious Google Doc sidebars and ClickOnce installers, identifiable by specific URI patterns and rare .application file references in process command lines.

blind_spots.risk: If traffic is encrypted and not inspected by a proxy, the specific HTML sidebar interaction may be invisible.
blind_spots.question: Can we see the specific URI path 'DecryptPanel.html' if it is loaded inside a Google Docs iframe via HTTPS?
blind_spots.remediation: Implement TLS inspection on egress traffic to cloud productivity suites.

blind_spots.risk: If command lines are truncated or not captured, the .application lure indicator will be missed.
blind_spots.question: Does the EDR capture the full command line for dfsvc.exe containing the .application URL?
blind_spots.remediation: Ensure process command line logging is enabled and not truncated for interpreter binaries.

hunt.name: Web-Based Delivery and Lure Interaction
hunt.description: This hunt focuses on the initial interaction with malicious document lures. It identifies hosts that have loaded the 'DecryptPanel.html' sidebar within Google Docs or downloaded the 'GapiUpdate.application' ClickOnce installer. By stack-counting ClickOnce execution events across the fleet and correlating them with known malicious domains used in recent post-DEF CON phishing campaigns, we can identify compromised systems before full payload execution.

config.content: SELECT hostname, platform, device_uid FROM hb_devices WHERE LOWER(platform) IN ('windows', 'darwin')
config.description: Identify the estate of Windows and macOS hosts that are targeted by the reported AMOS and NetSupport RAT delivery chains.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames representing the potential attack surface. Silence indicates no enrolled Windows or macOS devices.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_hostname, url_path, url_query, url_full, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (instr(LOWER(url_path), 'decryptpanel.html') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(url_query), 'decryptpanel.html') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(url_path), 'gapiupdate.application') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(url_query), 'gapiupdate.application') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{lure_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(url_hostname) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify hosts requesting the specific HTML sidebar or ClickOnce application file, checking both the path and query string.
config.expected_signal: Requests for DecryptPanel.html or GapiUpdate.application from any host. Silence suggests these specific lures haven't been accessed in the window.

primitive_config.label: HTTP Interaction with Malicious Lures
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_hostname, url_path, url_query, url_full, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (instr(LOWER(url_path), 'decryptpanel.html') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(url_query), 'decryptpanel.html') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(url_path), 'gapiupdate.application') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(url_query), 'gapiupdate.application') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{lure_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(url_hostname) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Requests for DecryptPanel.html or GapiUpdate.application from any host. Silence suggests these specific lures haven't been accessed in the window.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, process_name, COUNT(*) as lookup_count, MIN(time) as first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{lure_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname, process_name
config.description: Corroborate HTTP requests with DNS traffic to the specific domains named in the report.
config.expected_signal: A host resolving any of the campaign domains. Silence means no DNS activity for these specific strings.

primitive_config.label: DNS Resolution to Campaign Domains
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, process_name, COUNT(*) as lookup_count, MIN(time) as first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{lure_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname, process_name
primitive_config.expected: A host resolving any of the campaign domains. Silence means no DNS activity for these specific strings.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_name) as installer_name, LOWER(process_cmd_line) as cmd_line, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) as host_count, MIN(time) as first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%.application' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%.application' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%.application%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY installer_name, cmd_line HAVING host_count <= 3 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Stack-count the execution of .application files, including when they appear in the command line of interpreters like dfsvc.exe.
config.expected_signal: Installers appearing on very few hosts. Single-host ClickOnce installers are high-interest as they often deliver custom loaders.

primitive_config.label: Rare ClickOnce Installer Execution
